image_description: A vintage-style white fabric baby bib laid flat against a black background. The bib features a rounded, shield-like shape with scalloped edges. It has a neck opening with a fabric tie closure at the top. The center displays an embroidered or printed illustration of two cartoon bears (one pink, one blue) and the text 'M A O B' in blue block letters below the image.
